headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of August 21, 2026, the portfolio has delivered an average return of 24.48%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 12.99%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 11.50%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but also exceeding the benchmark's performance. The top portfolio, 'Random A,' has achieved an impressive return of 47.25%, contributing positively to the overall portfolio performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B,' has returned 11.04%, still above the SPY but less impactful. This relative strength against SPY is particularly notable during periods of market uncertainty, highlighting the portfolio's resilience. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
